intent.title.defaultMessage: Abrir a partir de outro servidor
intent.title.description: Title of the page that a follow or reply button of another server opens with the user's account on this server.

intent.follow.description.defaultMessage: Uma página em outro servidor enviou você para cá para seguir esta conta com a sua conta neste servidor:
intent.follow.description.description: Text above the address of the account that a follow button of another server names. The address follows it.

intent.follow.submit.description: Button that looks up the account a follow button of another server names and opens its profile, where the user can follow it.

intent.follow.not_found.description: Error when the address that a follow button of another server sent leads to no account.

intent.reply.description.defaultMessage: Uma página em outro servidor enviou você para cá para responder a esta publicação com a sua conta neste servidor:
intent.reply.description.description: Text above the address of the post that a reply button of another server names. The address follows it.

intent.reply.submit.description: Button that looks up the post a reply button of another server names, opens it, and starts a reply to it.

intent.reply.not_found.defaultMessage: Nenhuma publicação encontrada neste endereço, ou você não pode vê-la.
intent.reply.not_found.description: Error when the address that a reply button of another server sent leads to no post the user may see.

intent.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Muitas buscas. Tente novamente em alguns minutos.
intent.rate_limited.description: Error when the server limits how often the user can look up accounts and posts on other servers.

intent.known_only.defaultMessage: Este servidor não busca contas e publicações de outros servidores no momento.
intent.known_only.description: Error when this server does not take in other servers' accounts and posts (federation direction 'Send only' or 'Off'), so the account or post it does not know cannot be opened.

intent.failed.description: Error when looking up the account or post of a button of another server failed for another reason. {reason} is the localized reason.

intent.empty.defaultMessage: Este link não indica nenhuma conta ou publicação para abrir.
intent.empty.description: Text of the page that buttons of other servers open, when its address names nothing to follow or reply to.
